mentions.name: maximum-independent-set
mentions.description: An open-source tool that solves optimization problems using quantum computers, starting with the maximum independent set problem and being expanded to support more complex types of optimization problems.
mentions.source_excerpt: A tool to solve optimization problems using quantum computers. Just released the first open-source version https://github.com/pasqal-io/maximum-independent-set/ . Now expanding it to more complex types of optimization problems.
